نتراض (form VI)
# نَتَرَاضَ (natarāḍa) /na.ta.raː.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# نُتَرَاضَ (nutarāḍa) /nu.ta.raː.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
